data.title: 由比滨结衣 · 放学后的甜品店
data.description: 放学后的咖啡馆里，结衣捧着草莓奶油可丽饼，开心地咬下一口。柔和的灯光映着她泛红的脸颊，笑意怎么也藏不住——「这家的可丽饼真的很好吃！下次放学以后，我们也一起来吧。」
data.action: 捧着草莓奶油可丽饼品尝，开心地微笑
data.promptProse: Seated at a cozy shopping-street sweets cafe after school in her Sobu High School blazer and pink cardigan, Yui cradles a freshly folded strawberry-and-whipped-cream crepe in both hands. Taking a delighted bite with softly flushed cheeks, she beams across the wooden table with unmistakable after-school cheer. Warm afternoon sunlight through the cafe window brightens the sliced strawberries, cream swirls, and her lively smile.
data.animaCaption: Seated at the wooden cafe table in her school uniform and pink cardigan, Yui holds a strawberry-and-cream crepe with both hands and takes a happy bite with flushed cheeks. Warm afternoon window light brightens her cheerful smile and the dessert.
